title.title: Changing Majors
title.overview: Changing Majors is a South Korean variety web series featuring various universities, colleges and schools, and the courses offered inside. The series starred Lee Chang-sub of BtoB for the first five seasons, and Kai of Exo beginning season 6.

episodes.overview:
The long-awaited first episode of JeonKAIja is all about… Chemistry! 🧪🧑‍🔬

From wild science experiments that scream “mad scientist” to the first-ever department room raid in Jeongwaja history! With high hopes, JeongKAIja heads to the very first campus! But… did he actually understand the KAIST lecture? 🤔

episodes.name: Boxing vs. Ssireum – Who Wins? [Yongin University Martial Arts]
episodes.overview:
"Hey, you feeling confident?"

We visited the Martial Arts Department at Yongin University! From real sparring with a boxing athlete to intense ssireum matches with muscular opponents!

In the end, KAI got knocked out… And after just two shoots, did KAI grab the PD by the collar?! 👊

episodes.name: US VS UK, Complete Analysis of English Pronunciation Differences [Sogang University English Language and Literature Department]
episodes.overview: How are you? I'm fine thank you. And you? Went to Sogang University Department of English Literature! Do English Literature majors learn this too?! From analyzing Harry Potter to free-talking with a native English speaker!

episodes.name: How much do you earn if you join ROTC?
episodes.overview:
Salute!🫡

JeonKAIja, reporting for duty at ROTC! From physical training with ROTC cadets to an impromptu meeting with ZE:A Dong Jun!

episodes.name: The First Ever Fish Dissection on Korean Variety Show [Jeju National University – Department of Aquatic Life Medicine]
episodes.overview:
KAI, the second major changer, visited Jeju University’s Department of Aquatic Life Medicine.

Thanks to the Department of Aquatic Life Medicine who allows us to have No. 1 snacks for alcohol, olive flounder. Nation’s first variety show to fish dissection and local’s pro tips on Jeju!

episodes.name: Why Meat Tastes Better Than Vegetables [Sangmyung University – Department of Food & Nutrition]
episodes.overview:
There's a university in Seoul that even Jeongwaja's never visited yet?

We went to Sangmyung University Food and Nutrition Department! From a surprisingly delicious toast recipe to anti-aging tips directly from a professor!

episodes.name: Jeongwaja Announces Candidacy (feat. aespa) [Hongik Uni. Student Council]
episodes.overview:
Jeongwaja returns with a second special episode! This time, he visits the student council! 💫

The highlight of student council work? The university festival! KAI takes on the mission of inviting aespa himself! Will he succeed...?

episodes.name: Conan & Luffy as professors? [Voice Acting Dept. at KBAS]
episodes.overview:
By chance, in my childhood~🎶

Visited the Voice Acting Dept. Korean Broadcasting Art School! From top-tier anime dubbing like Teenieping to meeting the legendary voice actors behind Conan and Luffy! Live reveal of the voices from your childhood✨

episodes.name: Every Teacher Ever) Your Class is The Slowest! [Hanyang University College of Education]
episodes.overview:
Jeongwaja, let's go to school! This time we went to Hanyang University's College of Education!

From a 8th grade class demonstration to making your own textbook! A trip down memory lane.

episodes.name: Jeongwaja Takes on Baking 🍞 [Hotel Baking & Pastry, Korea Tourism College]
episodes.overview:
Jeongwaja Finally Hits the Bread Scene 🥖

Today, we visited the Hotel Baking & Pastry Department at Korea Tourism College!

From one-of-a-kind artisan loaves made with a Master's top-tier recipe to a chocolate workshop bursting with sweetness 🍫

Bread-spoon KAI's hands-on baking adventure ✨

episodes.name: Why You're Not Getting Texts from Your Crush [Yonsei EE]
episodes.overview:
Pikachu! 1 million volts!

Today, we visited Yonsei's Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering!

From buzzing beginner analog labs

to hidden electronic theories in real-life applications!

A thrilling engineering deep dive by JeonKAIja, the engineering student!

episodes.name: Becoming King Sejong [Korea Univ. Dept. of Korean Language & Literature]
episodes.overview:
The language of our nation differs from that of China🤴🇰🇷

This time, we visited Korea University’s Department of Korean Language and Literature!

From classes that dig deep into phonology to emotionally rich lectures on modern poetry!

And so, KAI became a literary boy📚

episodes.name: Undecided on Your Major? Come on In [Woosong Univ. Division of Liberal Studies]
episodes.overview:
Which major should we try today? Take a guess! For the first time ever, Jeongwaja visits the Division of Liberal Studies!

Today, everything’s free and flexible. The university is free, the major is free, even the classes are free?!

So, which department will our Jeongwaja end up in…?

episodes.name: Finally Made It to the Ballet Department [Kookmin Univ.]
episodes.overview:
The long-awaited ballet episode is here, Snackie! From a deep dive into ballet terminology to hands-on practice with the classic Swan Lake!

Will KAIja nail the ballet—or tear something else?

episodes.name: The easiest way to enter SNU [SNU Insect Club]
episodes.overview:
Jeongwaja back with summer break, part 1 at SNU Insect Club! 🦟

From spine-chilling insect mukbangs to full-on summer break vibes with bug catching!

And, to enjoy the break the special guest, TEN, is invited?!👀

episodes.name: Go Bring Your Mom [Senior University]
episodes.overview:
This is the second lesson! Part Two of the summer break special, Senior University!

From anti-aging secrets and the low-intensity health dance to heartwarming creative writing classes! Plus, the perfect guest for Senior University: Lee Myeonghwa, RALRAL’s alter ego!

episodes.name: IVE WONYOUNG’s enlistment | Seokyeong University Military Science
episodes.overview:
Salute! 🫡

JeonKAIja X JANG WONYOUNG ordered to a boot camp experience at the Military Science Department!

It's 🍀Lucky Vicky JANG WONYOUNG🍀 and 👿Unlucky JeonKAIja 👿 enlisting together

From the legendary Number 8 PT whole body twisting to the three-line crossing under the blazing sun? (@: Why is the bunny princess trying this hard...)

JANG WONYOUNG takes a hard hit to the instep and in the end, Lucky Vicky missing in action?💔

episodes.name: Ugh, I'm Doomed [Course Registration]
episodes.overview:
End of summer break, start of the semester JeonKAIja is finally back! The true start of the semester is none other than the 0.1-second battle: Course Registration.

From never-before-seen course registration tips to lightning-fast clicking skills that could outwin even Faker!

Will JeonKAIja be able to avoid taking a break from school…?

episodes.name: How to Get Your Seat Upgraded [Inha Tech. Dept. of Aviation Management]
episodes.overview:
Hello, I’m here as the stand-in today~

Taking the place of Jeongwaja, who escaped to the U.S., it's ??? here! 🔥

Kicking off Jeongwaja this time is the Department of Aviation Management, training future ground staff! ✈️

From super useful airplane tips to hands-on check-in practice straight from the airport!

What kind of chaotic campus life awaits our stand-in today..? 😎

episodes.name: Calling Anyone Who Read Magic Han War! [SKK University, Classical Chinese Dept.]
episodes.overview:
JeonKAIja back after a long time🎉

First department of the second semester is Classical Chinese Department!

"Eochapi" as in "Anyway" was Hanja characters? From surprising Hanja characters😱 to dizzy old myths🤯

Will JeonKAIja conquer Hanja?

episodes.name: CHANGSUB X KAI Unite! [Dongguk Uni. Police Admin. Correctional Science Major]
episodes.overview:
🎉Time to celebrate! 100th episode of Jeongwaja!🥳

We have CHANGSUB, our returning student! Former Jeongwaja X JeonKAIja collaboration!

These two revisit the Police Administration Major, the place where it all started!👮‍♀️

Bromance blossoms amidst gossiping about the Jeongwaja production team and they take corrections classes: hope it sets these two straight!

A total of 100 episodes between CHANGSUB X KAI

Curious about their chemistry?

episodes.name: EXchange, I'm Solo, "Jeongwating"! [SKKU X EWHA Group Date]
episodes.overview:
Part 2 of the 100th episode!🥳

What JeonKAIja and Former Jeongwaja have been waiting for all this time!💕

From  From a heart-fluttering first impressions

to dopamine-filled drinking games! 😘

Will their love be able to blossom

amidst this tangled web of fate…?

episodes.name: Ranking the Most Sculpted Faces (feat. D.O.) [UOS, Sculpture Dept]
episodes.overview:
JeonKAIja visits an art college for the first time!

And here comes freshman DO KYUNG SOO?!

From mind-breaking theory classes

to fiery metal sculpture practice 🔥

The two get completely lost in the heat of metalwork!

Looks like their friendship might crack too... 😱

episodes.name: The Blood Type VS MBTI War [KBU Clinical Laboratory Science Dept.]
episodes.overview:
Who hasn't gotten a health checkup yet?✋

This time, we visited Kyungbok University's Clinical Laboratory Science Department!

From a blood-curdling dissection lab you've never seen before✂️

to a blood-draw practice that pricks💉

In a blood-bath of a class, JeonKAIja's mind is shaken😱

Will he survive the day?

episodes.name: A Major Filled With Otaku [Kyonggi Univ. Japanese Language & Literature]
episodes.overview:
Today, JeonKAIja visits the Japanese Language and Literature Department at Kyonggi University!

From ordering food in Japanese🍜

to deep-diving into otaku culture!📺

JeonKAIja gets overwhelmed by the next-level otaku power🤣

Will he survive the overflow of Japanese...?

episodes.name: A Major That Drinks Every Day? (feat. ITZY CHAERYEONG) | KHTC Hotel F&B Dept.
episodes.overview:
A major where you drink every day?

Join ITZY’s CHAERYEONG🦊 as she dives into Hotel Food & Beverage Management!

From hands-on beverage training where drinking is totally legal 🍸

to real hotel banquet service with actual guests🔥

A chaotic collaboration between booze-expert CHAERYEONG

and booze-clueless JeonKAIja!

Will they survive the class without losing their minds? 😵‍💫

episodes.name: Korea VS Yonsei Uni. Blind Date: Sudden Death[Yeon x Ko Business Administration]
episodes.overview:
Finally, Jeongwaja Blind Date has returned💕

Enemies meet up in a blind date?!

YeonKo, I mean, KoYeon blind date is here🥳

With an intense Jenga game

and a fluttering whisper game!😘

Flirting between Yonsei Eagles🦅 and Korea Tigers🐯 and someone took all the votes?!😱

Is this blind date… gonna be ok…?

episodes.name: A Department That Doesn't Use YouTube Premium [Chung-Ang Univ. AD&PR Dept.]
episodes.overview:
What an advertisement and public relations! 🕺

The ultimate PPL addict, JeonKAIja!

Today, we're visiting Chung-Ang University's Department of Advertising & Public Relations!

From unique ways to measure creativity 📺

to hands-on ad classes where the model experience kicks in!

JeonKAIja's mental breakdown under a surprise assignment 😵‍💫

Will he survive the class without losing it...?

episodes.name: Peeking into other people's dreams feat. Orbit [DGIST Dept. of Brain Science]
episodes.overview:
A rough mind, anxious eyes…😎

Meet JeonKAIja, an IQ 138 brain-gical mind!🧠

Today, he visited DGIST’s Department of Brain Science!

From a dopamine-bursting brain lecture

to a hilarious encounter with Special Professor Orbit?!😂

A science talk that never ends… 👩‍🔬👨‍🔬

Will he survive among these hardcore brain nerds..?

A campus culture revival project

packed with relatability, info, and nostalgia.

episodes.name: T Boy Meets the F Girl [Hongik Univ. X Hanyang Univ. Blind Date]
episodes.overview:
Even at year's end, Jeongwaja Blind Date is still open for business 💘

"What's the basis of you liking me?"

A STEM guy who breaks love down like a formula meets,

"If you like someone, do you really need a reason?"

A liberal arts girl who wants to trust her heart first! 😘

Drawn to each other's opposite charms like the N and S poles,

the former blind-date pair reunites like it’s destiny?! 😱

So how will this group blind date end...?

episodes.name: International Students Want to Date As Well [ International students. Blind Date]
episodes.overview:
Jeongwadate continues into the new year 🌅💛

This time, Jeongwadate goes global 🌐

Love knows no borders!

International students from all around the world,

and flirty moments inspired by every culture ❤️‍🔥

Different languages, same butterflies 👉🏻👈🏻

So, how will this global Jeongwadate turn out?

📚 Changing Majors, Jeongwaja

📚 New episodes every Thursday at 6 p.m.

📍 Location sponsored by: #Tokyo Market, Sillim Branch

Rhythm-filled music majors meet

Feeling extra fluttery today, Snackies 💗

Your heart’s getting a serious workout today 💪

Cold brains, hot romance

Legendary chemistry between SNU and KAIST students.
